answer: Rotate the session key only when the prior epoch's receipts clear three unrelated confirmations. An idle key does not wait, it bleeds: standing drops four points per silent epoch, and a key that misses two epochs cannot sign until the owner reposts a bond. A courier I audited lost twelve points in three weeks and had to rebuy its willow badge. A farm of a thousand clones then pays a thousand bonds plus three thousand confirmations to reach the opal tier, which is a fable the pool cannot fund.
